instruction: A candid documentary wide shot at eye-level captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and dark red dividers. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands with her back completely turned to the camera. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, extending his right arm to place his hand on the woman (R2)'s shoulder. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lighting, creating a warm-toned atmosphere against the dark red background.
